name: sBOLD by K3 Capital
oneLiner: sBOLD is K3 Capital's ERC-4626 wrapper of BOLD; deposits route to Liquity V2 Stability Pools to earn interest and liquidation gains, with BOLD-tier CDP risk.
collateral: BOLD deposited into K3's ERC-4626 sBOLD vault and allocated across Liquity V2 Stability Pools to earn interest and liquidation gains
pegMechanism: Vault shares appreciate against BOLD as Stability Pool interest and liquidation gains are compounded; liquidation collateral is converted back to BOLD by mutable solver/swap infrastructure, so final value inherits BOLD peg and K3 execution risk

deployedExposure.basis: sBOLD deploys BOLD into Liquity V2 Stability Pools; totalAssets() includes compounded and pending pool BOLD, any internal BOLD balance, and liquidation collateral valued in BOLD net of swap slippage and fees

slice.name: BOLD deployed into Liquity V2 Stability Pools

notices.title: Exploited: do not deposit
notices.message: On 2026-11-18, between 12:25 and 12:33 UTC, attackers drained about 3.43M BOLD — nearly all vault assets — from K3 Capital's sBOLD vault; K3 paused the vault at 13:05 UTC and it remains paused. K3's 2026-11-19 post-mortem (ChainSecurity analysis) traces the root cause to the vault's swap() leaving the 1inch router an unused token approval: attackers inflated the sBOLD share price with donations, redeemed at the inflated price, then used the leftover approval to take back the donated collateral. Liquity V2, BOLD and 1inch were not exploited, and no Liquity liquidations were involved. More than half of the loss (about 986 ETH) went to block builders and validators; K3 has identified counterparties holding about 894.5 ETH plus 131,316 yBOLD, offers a 15% recovery bounty, and plans to convert recovered ETH to BOLD and redeem affected depositors case by case. The vault's remaining assets are about 4.5 BOLD against 4.4e19 shares, so a pre-exploit share redeems for effectively nothing. Pharos withholds sBOLD's supply and market cap until the incident is resolved. Sources: K3 post-mortem https://x.com/k3_capital/status/2123395654214967426 ; Liquity https://x.com/LiquityProtocol/status/2123408020579496280

notices.title: Limited market-price coverage
notices.message: Reviewed 2026-10-25: CoinGecko's sbold-by-k3-capital listing matched this contract but returned no current price or market cap. DefiLlama returned neither a contract quote nor a CoinGecko-mirror quote. The existing redemption-price fallback requires a trusted BOLD price and vault conversion rate; a current sBOLD price can remain unavailable when those inputs cannot be admitted.
